title: leptospermum styphelioides
intro: Leptospermum styphelioides, commonly known as Prickly Tea Tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrtaceae. This plant is valued for its leaves and flowers, which have been traditionally used in herbal medicine for their anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The health benefits of Leptospermum styphelioides include wound healing, skin protection, and relief from respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
